summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 13.0.0 supports FortiOS 7.6.3 and 7.6.4 and username/password authentication on 7.6.4.
questions: Which FortiOS versions does fortinet.fortios support in Ansible 13?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 7.6.3 and 7.6.4
answer_card.answer_md: fortinet.fortios added support for FortiOS **7.6.3 and 7.6.4**, including username/password authentication on 7.6.4.
